purpose: Same-machine, same-release-build M0 local reference and M1 mixed local/OpenSSH comparison. Replaces missing quantitative evidence, not historical human reports.

scope: Loopback WSL OpenSSH, one visible pane with WebGL, synthetic fixed output. Numerical margins allow SSH transport/authentication and scheduling overhead. Record actual CPU, RTT, negotiated algorithms, DPI and WebView2. No WAN, ARM64 or hardware-matrix claim. Retain failures; never loosen limits after a run.
